title: Choir Vault Ascension: Threshold Sign
description: Choir Vault Ascension unfolds across upper choir gate where song, law, and Hollow silence collide, pushing a one active Empyrean Titan to prove protection, order-locks, shields, anti-chaos control, battle lineless aura play. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Choir Vault Ascension: Threshold Sign advances Empyrean Choir Vault: The Radiant Hierarchies ascend a broken heaven-engine where order can stabilize worlds or erase dissonant survivors. It directly tests the faction tension: Their mercy is real, but so is their judgment. Allies fear becoming evidence in an Empyrean trial.
terrain: upper choir gate where song, law, and Hollow silence collide

objectives.primary: Secure the The Choir-Axiom Gate approach before Hollow pressure rewrites the field.
optional: Keep your active Titan above 40% integrity
Trigger at least two Empyrean faction mechanics

reinforcement from the Gate wound flank

specialRules: Choir Lock: beacon timing shields battle line if objectives resolve in order.
